title: Friendships That Simply Stop
sentences: Very few of my friendships have ended in an argument.
Almost all of them have ended by gradually running out of occasions.
One person moves, the shared routine disappears, and nothing replaces it.
There is rarely a moment you could point to afterwards.
That absence of a moment makes the loss difficult to discuss.
You cannot easily mourn something that nobody declared over.
I have started treating certain friendships as things requiring maintenance.
It feels unromantic, and it has kept three of them alive.
The ones I lost were not weaker than the ones I kept.
They were simply the ones where neither of us made the arrangements.
